title: Seabridge Gold Files Third Quarter 2026 Report to Shareholders, Financial Statements and MD&A
body_markdown:
Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 12, 2026) - Seabridge Gold Inc. (TSX: SEA) (NYSE: SA) announced today, that it has filed its Report to Shareholders, Interim Financial Statements and Management's Discussion and Analysis for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 on[SEDAR+](https://api.newsfilecorp.com/redirect/ZEZ8ZubNXz) . These documents are also available on the Company website at[https://www.seabridgegold.com/investors/financial-reports](https://api.newsfilecorp.com/redirect/anZzZHXyjD) .


**About Seabridge Gold** Seabridge Gold holds a 100% interest in several North American gold projects. Its principal assets are the KSM and Bronson Corridor projects in British Columbia's Golden Triangle. Additional projects include Snowstorm in Nevada's Getchell Gold Belt, and the 3 Aces project in the Yukon. Further information on Seabridge's mineral reserves and resources is available at[http://www.seabridgegold.com](https://api.newsfilecorp.com/redirect/24V0VCWmx1) .
